# Unboxed Thinking

> Unboxed Thinking is a digital marketing and web development studio working with brands in India and the UAE. One team plans the website, the campaigns and the search visibility together.

## Services
- Website & e-commerce development: business websites, landing pages, WordPress, custom builds, online stores
- SEO, AEO & GEO: technical and on-page SEO, structured data, answer-ready content, visibility in Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity
- Google Ads: search, Performance Max, shopping, conversion tracking
- Meta, Pinterest & social media: Facebook, Instagram and Pinterest ads, content planning, profile management
- LinkedIn & B2B lead generation: outreach, LinkedIn campaigns, lead funnels
- WhatsApp marketing & branding: WhatsApp campaigns, click-to-chat flows, brand identity
